Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap Show pictures or Show description on a move to see how it's done.
How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Cycling / bike
1 set3 minsBike machineBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Set the saddle so the knee has a slight bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke, hands on the bars, torso relaxed.

Movement: Pedal at the set pace or resistance for the set time, keeping a smooth steady rhythm.

Focus: Keep the pedalling smooth and the knees tracking straight, not rolling in or out. Sit with a relaxed upright posture, and build the pace or resistance gradually.

Goblet squat
2 sets8-10 repsAny kit4kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest with both hands, elbows tucked down, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down into a squat, keeping the weight at the chest and the torso upright, then drive up through the heels to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes, never caving in, and the heels flat. Keep the chest up and the weight close, and squat only as deep as you can control comfortably.

Romanian deadlift – staggered stance
2 sets8-10 repsAny kit10kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: One foot flat, the other half a step back on its toes. Weight in front of the thighs, soft bend in the front knee.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the weight down the front leg until the hamstring loads, then drive the hips forward to stand tall. Swap legs halfway.

Focus: Most of the weight sits on the front leg, the back foot is only there for balance. Back flat, hips square, not twisting open.

Cross trainer
1 set5 minsCross trainerBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall on the pedals, feet flat, hands on the handles, torso upright, core gently engaged.

Movement: Move the pedals and handles through a smooth striding rhythm for the set time or effort.

Focus: Stand tall with a relaxed upright posture, not slumping on the handles. Keep the stride smooth and even, and build the pace or resistance gradually.

Chest press – cable
3 sets10 repsCable2 x 7kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand at a chest-height cable, a handle in each hand at the chest, staggered stance, shoulder blades set, core braced.

Movement: Press the handles forward together until the arms are nearly straight, then return under control to the chest.

Focus: Keep the shoulder blades set and the ribs down, not arching to press. Keep the torso square and still, resisting the cable's pull to twist you. Keep the elbows a little below shoulder height, and control the return.

Pallof press
3 sets8 each sideCable/Band7kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand side-on to a cable or band at chest height, feet shoulder-width, hands holding the handle at the chest, core braced.

Movement: Press the handle straight out in front of you, resisting the pull that wants to rotate you, hold briefly, then draw it back.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square, letting nothing rotate you towards the cable, this is the whole exercise. Keep the ribs down and the core braced, and press smoothly rather than snatching.

Pad work
3 sets10 repsBoxing padsBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand in a balanced stance, hands up, knees soft, core engaged, facing the pads.

Movement: Strike the pads through the set combinations, returning the hands to guard each time, in rhythm.

Focus: Keep the movements controlled and the wrist firm on contact, not over-reaching or snapping the elbow. Stay balanced with soft knees, and keep the core engaged.

Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap a move for cues.
How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Swings – KB
2 sets8-10 repsKB10kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor in front, feet hip-width, hinged with a flat back, core braced.

Movement: Hike the kettlebell back between the legs, then drive the hips forward to swing it up to about chest height, letting it swing back down into the next hinge.

Focus: Power the swing from a sharp hip drive, not the arms or lower back, keeping the back flat throughout. Snap the glutes at the top with the ribs down, and let the arms just guide the bell.

Bent-over row – BB underhand
3 sets10-12 repsBarbell10kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a barbell underhand at arms' length, chest up, hips back, core braced.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the lower abdomen, driving the elbows back close to the body, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hinge steady, not rounding as you row. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and keep the wrists straight.

Cross trainer
5 minsCross trainerBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall on the pedals, feet flat, hands on the handles, torso upright, core gently engaged.

Movement: Move the pedals and handles through a smooth striding rhythm for the set time or effort.

Focus: Stand tall with a relaxed upright posture, not slumping on the handles. Keep the stride smooth and even, and build the pace or resistance gradually.

Dead bug – arms and legs
3 sets10-12 each sideMatBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent over the hips, arms towards the ceiling, lower back pressed gently into the floor.

Movement: Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly towards the floor, keeping the back flat, then return and swap sides.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor as the limbs extend, never letting it arch. Move slowly and controlled, and shorten the reach if the back lifts.

Sit-ups
3 sets10 repsMatBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, hands across the chest or lightly behind the head, ribs down.

Movement: Curl up from the floor one vertebra at a time until the torso is upright over the hips, then lower back down under control.

Focus: Curl rather than swing, keeping the neck neutral and the feet down without hooking them under anything. Lower slowly instead of dropping, and stop short of the range if the lower back complains.

Movement: Strike the pads through the set combinations, returning the hands to guard each time, in rhythm.

Focus: Keep the movements controlled and the wrist firm on contact, not over-reaching or snapping the elbow. Stay balanced with soft knees, and keep the core engaged.

Box squat – goblet

Start: Stand in front of a box at about parallel height holding a weight at the chest, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down to lightly touch the box, then drive up through the heels to stand tall, keeping the weight at the chest.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes and the heels down. Touch the box under control rather than dropping, and keep the chest up and the weight close throughout.

2 x 8-10 · ~5kg
Suitcase deadlift

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, a single weight on the floor beside one foot.

Movement: Hinge and bend the knees to take the weight, then drive through the floor and stand tall with it at your side. Lower under control. Swap sides halfway.

Focus: The load is on one side, so the trunk has to stop you leaning towards it. Shoulders and hips level all the way, back flat, weight close to the leg.

2 x 8-10 each side · Moderate

Focus: Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft, staying tall as the knee drives up. Fix the eyes on a point, control the drive and lower, and keep the core engaged.

Box squat – weighted

Start: Stand in front of a box at about knee height holding a light weight at the chest, feet hip to shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down to lightly touch the box, then stand tall through the heels, keeping the weight at the chest.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the chest up. Sit back under control rather than dropping onto the box, and drive up through the heels.

3 x 10-12 · 5kg
Cross trainer

Start: Stand tall on the pedals, feet flat, hands on the handles, torso upright, core gently engaged.

Movement: Move the pedals and handles through a smooth striding rhythm for the set time or effort.

Focus: Stand tall with a relaxed upright posture, not slumping on the handles. Keep the stride smooth and even, and build the pace or resistance gradually.

5 mins
Romanian deadlift – BB

Start: Stand tall with a barbell held at the front of your thighs, hands just outside your legs, feet hip-width. Set the shoulders back, brace the core hard, and keep a soft bend in the knees.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the bar down the front of your legs, keeping it in contact, until you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings. Keep the knees still and the shins vertical. Drive the hips forward to stand tall and finish with the glutes.

Focus: The back stays flat from start to finish, never rounded. This is a hip hinge, not a squat, so the movement happens at the hips while the bar tracks close to the legs. Only lower as far as you can hold a flat back, and don't lean back or over-arch at the top.

3 x 8-10 · 10kg
Row – landmine, single arm

Start: Straddle or stand beside a landmine bar, hinge with a flat back, one hand on the bar end, arm extended, core braced.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the hip, driving the elbow back, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hips still, leading with the elbow and squeezing the shoulder blade. Don't round or twist to lift, and control the lower.

3 x 10-12 each side · 15kg bar
Elbow plank

Start: Set your forearms on the floor shoulder-width, elbows under the shoulders, legs extended back, toes tucked under.

Movement: Lift the hips to form a straight line from head to heels and hold that position for the set time, breathing steadily.

Focus: Keep a straight line, hips neither sagging down nor piking up, and the core and glutes braced. Keep the ribs down and the neck long, and stop when the line breaks rather than pushing through a drooping back.

3 x 30 sec

w/c 12 Oct 2026 · Squat & Hinge & Push▼
Squat – trap bar

Start: Stand in the centre of the trap bar, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Use the raised handles where the bar has them. Squat down with the chest tall and grip the handles in the middle.

Movement: Drive up through the heels to stand tall, then sit straight down between the handles, knees travelling forward over the toes and the torso staying upright. A squat with the load at your sides, so nothing sits on the back or shoulders.

Focus: Corkscrew the feet into the floor so the knees track over the toes, never caving in, and keep the heels down. Sit down rather than back, and take depth only as far as the knees are comfortable.

3 x 8-10 · Moderate
Clean – DB

Start: Stand with dumbbells at the thighs or floor, feet hip-width, hinged with a flat back, core braced.

Movement: Drive up through the hips to pull the dumbbells up and catch them at the shoulders, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat and drive from the hips and legs, not yanking with the arms or rounding. Catch softly at the shoulders with the ribs down, and control the lower.

3 x 10-12 · 4kg
Incline press

Start: Lie on an incline bench, a weight in each hand at upper-chest height, shoulder blades set back, feet planted.

Movement: Press the the weights up until the arms are nearly straight, then lower under control to a comfortable stretch.

Focus: Keep the shoulder blades set on the bench and the elbows at about 45 degrees, not flared wide. Keep the ribs down, and control the lower to a comfortable shoulder range.

3 x 10 · 2 x 4kg
ISO single leg deadlift – supported

Start: Stand on one leg, soft knee, weight held in front of the thigh, fingertips on a chair back or worktop in front of you.

Movement: Hinge at the hip and lower the weight down the standing leg while the free leg lifts behind, reach a flat-backed stretch, then hold still.

Focus: Back flat, hips level, don't let the raised hip open out. Light fingertip support only, enough to steady you, and take the hand away when you feel steady.

3 x 30s each side · Moderate
Leg extension – bilateral

Start: Sit at the machine, shins behind the pad, knees at the pivot, thighs supported, holding the handles.

Movement: Straighten the knees to raise the pad, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Raise and lower under control, never kicking or snapping the knees straight. Keep the range comfortable and pain-free, and pause briefly at the top rather than locking hard.

3 x 10 · 8.25kg
Anterior tibialis toe raises

Start: Stand with the back against a wall or sit tall, heels down, toes free to lift.

Movement: Raise the toes and fronts of the feet up towards the shins, then lower under control.

Focus: Move only at the ankles, raising the toes as high as you can, and control the lower. Keep it slow and deliberate, feeling the front of the shin work.

3 x 10 · Bodyweight
Adductor squeeze – Swiss ball

Start: Lie or sit with a Swiss ball between the knees or lower thighs, torso relaxed, core gently engaged.

Movement: Squeeze the ball between the legs, hold briefly, then release slowly under control.

Focus: Squeeze smoothly and hold the effort, then release slowly rather than letting go. Keep the breathing steady, and keep the effort within a comfortable range.

3 x 30s · Bodyweight
w/c 12 Oct 2026 · Hinge & Pull & Carry▼
Pull-through – band

Start: Stand facing away from a low band, the band between the legs held in both hands, hinged forward with a flat back, core braced.

Movement: Drive the hips forward to stand tall, pulling the band through, squeezing the glutes, then hinge back under control.

Focus: Drive the movement from the hips and glutes, not the arms or lower back, keeping the back flat. Stand tall with the ribs down at the top, and control the hinge back.

3 x 10-12 · Light
Hip row – BB

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a barbell at arms' length, chest up, core braced, hips back.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the hips, driving the elbows back, then lower under control while holding the hinge.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hinge steady throughout, not rising or rounding as you row. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and keep the shoulders down.

3 x 10-12 · Moderate
Farmer's carries – trap bar

Start: Deadlift the trap bar to standing, gripping the handles in the middle, feet hip-width, ribs down, shoulders back.

Movement: Walk forward with short, controlled steps for the set distance, then stop, settle and lower the bar with a flat back. The frame lets you carry more than two dumbbells with the load balanced.

Focus: Stand tall with the ribs down and shoulders back, not letting the load pull you into a slump. Keep the bar level and steady, not rocking front to back.

3 x 20m · Moderate
Curl and overhead extension – BB

Start: Stand tall holding a bar at the thighs with an underhand grip, elbows pinned to the sides, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Curl the bar to the shoulders, press it overhead, lower it behind the head by bending the elbows, then reverse the whole path to return.

Focus: Keep the elbows still through the curl rather than letting them travel forward, and keep the ribs down through the overhead portion rather than arching the back. Control the bar on the way back down, which is where most of the work is.

3 x 10-12 · Moderate
Single leg deadlift – bodyweight

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, the other leg ready to travel back, standing knee soft, arms ready.

Movement: Hinge forward from the hip, letting the free leg travel back and the arms lower, then return to standing.

Focus: Hinge from the hip with a flat back, keeping the hips level and not opening out. Keep the standing knee soft, move slowly, and control the return.

3 x 10-12 each side · Bodyweight
Lateral band walks – diagonal

Start: Stand with a band around the legs, feet hip-width, knees softly bent, slight squat, torso tall.

Movement: Step diagonally forward and outward alternately, keeping tension on the band, for the set steps.

Focus: Keep tension on the band and the knees driving out, not caving. Stay low and controlled, and feel the outer hips working each step.

3 x 10-12 · Light
Hollow body hold

Start: Lie on your back, arms overhead, legs straight, lower back pressed firmly into the floor.

Movement: Lift the shoulders and legs a little off the floor into a shallow dish shape and hold, keeping the back flat.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor, never letting it arch up, this protects the spine. Raise the limbs only as high as you can hold that flat back, lowering them if it lifts.

3 x 30s · Bodyweight
World's greatest stretch

Start: Step into a deep lunge, the back leg straight, hands framing the front foot on the floor.

Movement: Drop the back elbow towards the floor inside the front foot, then rotate the same arm up towards the ceiling, opening the chest, before returning.

Focus: Move into each part only to a comfortable range, keeping the front knee stable over the foot. Let the rotation come from the upper back, and breathe through the positions.

3 x 30s · Bodyweight

Goblet squat – pause at bottom

Start: Hold a weight at the chest with both hands, elbows tucked, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit down into a squat, pause for two to three seconds at the bottom holding still, then drive up through the heels to stand.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the heels down through the pause. Keep the chest up and the weight close, and pause only at a depth you control comfortably.

Deadlift – trap bar

Start: Stand in the centre of the trap bar, feet hip-width, the handles in line with the middle of your feet. Hinge down and grip the handles in the middle, chest up, back flat, core braced.

Movement: Push the floor away and stand tall, hips and shoulders rising together. Finish standing tall with the glutes, then sit the hips back and lower the bar under control to the floor.

Focus: The back stays flat from floor to lockout, never rounded. Push through the whole foot with the heels down, and stand tall at the top without leaning back.

Thread the needle – ViPR
